* '''Original''' ([[Odd Ball's Torrent Starfighter]], 18 March 2021): Original: the first Players Committee card image in the Holotable image set (18 March 2021, published with the Virtual Set 14 images); Virtual Set 15 was released 23 June 2021. Players Committee card image, 18 March 2021: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-oddballstorrentstarfighter-20210318.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/oddballstorrentstarfighter.png Holotable commit c241f88 “vset14”], no mark). Text: “May add 1 clone pilot. Odd Ball deploys -1 aboard. While Odd Ball piloting, power and hyperspeed +1, and adds one destiny to total power. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while Odd Ball piloting).”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 20 April 2022): Players Committee card image, 20 April 2022: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-oddballstorrentstarfighter.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d50/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/oddballstorrentstarfighter.png Holotable commit 2640d50 “Set 18 and errata”], no mark). Text: “May add 1 clone pilot. Odd Ball deploys -1 aboard. While Odd Ball piloting, power and hyperspeed +1, and adds one destiny to total power. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while Odd Ball piloting).” '''What changed:''' the card was re-rendered at a higher resolution (745×1039, was 703×980): art credit “Image courtesy of Tupalo @ Behance” (was “www.behance.net/tupalo”), copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”; the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
